capabilities: Fetch hotlink-protected media files with the headers the source site expects
Hand fetched files to embedded video, audio and image elements as blob URLs
Refresh rejected media URLs by re-fetching the original article and retrying
Show a note with a link to the original page when playback still fails
disambiguation: Not a link-management tool; it makes hotlink-protected embedded media play instead of failing with HTTP 403.
extras: Desktop only: requests use Node's http/https modules because browsers and Electron's network stack do not reliably allow setting the Referer header. No telemetry; files are held in memory only and nothing is written to the vault. Adds new site rules by editing RULES in src/rules.ts.
intentEvidence: Takes over the element: moves the URL aside so Obsidian doesn't request it and fail.
problem: Servers that check the Referer header reject requests from Obsidian's app://obsidian.md origin, so embedded media from such sites shows as a black box instead of playing.

relations.evidence: Hotlink Media is now part of Media One, as its Hotlink-protected media module.

summary: Plays hotlink-protected videos, audio and images embedded in notes by fetching them with the Referer and other headers the source site expects.
